translations.web: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”
translations.bsb: Or if the scroll is handed to one unable to read, he will say, “I cannot read.”
translations.kjv: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
